basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Gas detectors (fixed) - applies from the 2015 and subsequent income years
basis.note: Printed page 48. Fixed gas detectors. Same life under REFR p.52, SCIA p.53 and WATR p.57. Printed DV 20%, SL 13.5%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.
